subject: IAM artifact collection & workback plan for FinLedger security questionnaire
messages:
From: Claire Liu <claire.liu@finledger.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Amir Khan <amir.khan@finledger.com>, security@finledger.com
Date: 2027-04-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: FinLedger SIG + SOC2 follow-up — IAM artifacts request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. The procurement/security team asked for a consolidated set of IAM artifacts to complete our SIG questionnaire and SOC 2 scoping items. We prefer to receive everything in one package but understand some items will be exports or screenshots.

Can you confirm you can provide the following by next Tuesday (2027-04-26)?
- SAML 2.0 metadata (IdP/SP) and any public certs
- SCIM provisioning logs for the last 30 days (CSV or JSON)
- Current RBAC role definitions and a mapping of roles -> permissions
- Evidence of least-privilege enforcement (policy snippets or examples)
- Audit log extract for user provisioning events (indexed by date and actor)

If any of these need a different timeline, please tell us what you can do and any blockers. We can accept drive links or an SFTP drop.

Appreciate it — Claire
Claire Liu
Security Program Manager, FinLedger

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Liu <claire.liu@finledger.com>
Cc: Amir Khan <amir.khan@finledger.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLedger SIG + SOC2 follow-up — IAM artifacts request

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide all of these items; I want to outline a short workback so expectations are aligned and we can escalate anything that needs engineering time. High-level plan: 

1) Today (2027-04-18): confirm owners + any PII redaction needs.
2) Tomorrow (2027-04-19): export RBAC definitions and SAML metadata; upload to a secure Drive folder.
3) 2027-04-20: SCIM provisioning logs (30 days) + audit extract (CSV) — note: SCIM logs require a scoped export from the provisioning pipeline.
4) 2027-04-20: produce a short "least-privilege" summary with example policy snippets and verification steps.

Owners: Laura will take RBAC and policy snippets; Rishi will run the SCIM/log exports and audit extracts. I'll collate and upload to the Drive link and create checksums.

Please confirm if the Drive link is acceptable and whether FinLedger needs redaction (usernames replaced with pseudonyms or hashed emails). If you need an SFTP instead, we can support that too.

Deliverables and file formats we will provide:
- redwood-saml-metadata.xml (SP metadata, cert chain)
- scim-provisioning-log-20270410.csv (30-day export, minimal PII)
- rbac-export-roles-20270415.json (role objects + permissions)
- audit-provisioning-20270401-20270418.csv (provisioning events)
- least-privilege-summary.pdf (1-page description + policy snippets)
- sso-test-screencast.mp4 (short login flow for SAML SSO)

If that map works, we’ll target to upload the first tranche tomorrow morning.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: FinLedger artifacts — action items and owners

Team — quick internal note. Claire at FinLedger asked for the artifact package for SIG/SOC2. Per our call: Laura = RBAC + least-privilege writeup; Rishi = SCIM + audit exports; Evelyn, can you help with the SAML metadata export and generate the SSO test screencast? I may need engineering access for the provisioning logs if Rishi hits rate limits.

Action items: 
- Laura: export roles and produce rbac-export-roles-20270415.json by EOD 2027-04-19. Include a mapping table (role -> permissions) and highlight any overly-permissive entries.
- Rishi: schedule SCIM export for 30 days and run audit-provisioning-20270401-20270418.csv. If you need DB access, request via infra ticket INFRA-472.
- Evelyn: produce redwood-saml-metadata.xml and the sso-test-screencast.mp4 (2–3 min). Add public certs to the Drive folder.

I'll collate and upload. If anyone expects blocking work longer than one business day, flag me.

Thanks — Soojin

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Liu <claire.liu@finledger.com>
Cc: Amir Khan <amir.khan@finledger.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Delivering IAM artifacts — FinLedger SIG/SOC2 package

Hi Claire —

Attached is the package we discussed. I uploaded the files to a secure Drive folder and added FinLedger with view-only access. We also generated checksums and a short manifest. Below is a quick inventory; the Drive link is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-FinLedger-IAM

Inventory (files):
- redwood-saml-metadata.xml — SP metadata + cert chain (public certs included)
- scim-provisioning-log-20270410.csv — SCIM provisioning events (30 days), usernames hashed per our standard process
- rbac-export-roles-20270415.json — role objects and permissions mapping (documented)
- audit-provisioning-20270401-20270418.csv — provisioning events with actor IDs (actor IDs are internal IDs, not raw emails)
- least-privilege-summary.pdf — 1-page summary of how RBAC and permission reviews are conducted
- sso-test-screencast.mp4 — short recording demonstrating SSO login, SAML assertion validation, and IdP metadata exchange

Notes and caveats: 
- We hashed usernames and removed direct email addresses from the SCIM export to minimize PII exposure. If FinLedger needs unhashed identifiers for testing, we can provide a redacted mapping under an NDA.
- Audit extracts include actor IDs; we can map IDs to human-readable names if required for the audit, but that requires a procurement-signed data access agreement.
- If you need PKI validation beyond the cert chain we supplied, let us know and we can provide the CA bundle.

If everything looks good, I’ll mark this delivery as complete in our tracker (HubSpot DL-9381) and await any follow-up Qs.

Best regards,
— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: [redwood-saml-metadata.xml (application/xml), scim-provisioning-log-20270410.csv (text/csv), rbac-export-roles-20270415.json (application/json), audit-provisioning-20270401-20270418.csv (text/csv), least-privilege-summary.pdf (application/pdf), sso-test-screencast.mp4 (video/mp4)]
